lead.note: **266 Big Bend (USFS, WV)** — entry riverfront on the --AWH note ("sites adjacent to the water"); rec.gov and the FS page say "The river is located 200 feet from campground".
lead.prior_evidence: Firsthand manual audit by owner (--AWH note); waterfront 'riverfront' per owner: USFS campground along the South Branch of the Potomac River in the Smoke Hole canyon with sites adjacent to the water.  Some sites are reservable.  Open early April to late October.

lead.note: **1227 East Fork (WV)** — operator: "waterside" sites, "primitive waterfront sites", a river that "runs the length of the campground"; entry riverview.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 38.5448,-79.8232: open grass campground loop adjacent to East Fork Greenbrier bend; visible RVs set back ~50-100m, spaced bank trees between loop and river — view plausible, no RV pads at waterline

lead.note: **426 Riverside Cabins & RV Park (WV)**: operator says "RV Sites – On the bank of the Potomac River"; entry is riverview, and the --AWH note says the RV sites are set back from the river.
lead.prior_evidence: Firsthand manual audit by owner (--AWH note); waterfront 'riverview' per owner: Private RV park on the South Branch of the Potomac River with tent sites along the riverbank.  RV sites are set back from the river.

lead.note: **490 Riverside, Watoga SP (WV)** (weak): the booking site tags ~20 sites "Riverview" and none "Riverfront"; entry is riverfront (--AWH firsthand).
lead.prior_evidence: Firsthand manual audit by owner (--AWH note); waterfront 'riverfront' per owner: Wooded campground on the western site of Watoga State Park.  Campground is alongside the Greenbrier River and several sites back up to the river.

lead.note: **263 Summersville Lake Retreat (WV)**: FAQ "We overlook Summersville Lake and have a fantastic view of the lake but we do not have direct access"; premium sites "stare out on Summersville Lake". Entry is not waterfront, so a view tier may be earned.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 38.1995,-80.8666: rows of RV pull-thru pads in an upland clearing, no water adjacent (Summersville Lake well off-frame); note confirms no lakefront sites -> not waterfront

lead.note: **498 Army Camp, NPS (WV)**: NPS says the sites are "along the banks of the New River at one of its many horseshoe bends"; entry is not waterfront (--AWH says the sites are not waterfront).
lead.prior_evidence: Firsthand manual audit by owner (--AWH note); waterfront 'not waterfront' per owner: Small NPS campground along the New River.  Campsites are set back in the woods and are close to the river but not waterfont.

lead.note: **1192 Great Bend (WV)**: the city says it's "Nestled along the Sandy Creek close to where it flows into the Ohio River"; entry riverfront, so the water at the sites may be the creek.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 38.9465,-81.7576: curving row of RV pads ~10-20m from waterline along Sandy Creek embayment of the Ohio River, next to boat docks

lead.note: **83 Stuart Recreation Area (WV)**: rec.gov says "perched along a bend on the Shavers Fork River" and "along the banks"; entry riverview.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite at 38.9187,-79.7729: open grassy camp loop with parked RVs along Shavers Fork bend, river visible ~30-60m W across open grass but a continuous riparian treeline screens the actual bank -> riverview, not riverfront (note's 'Greenbrier River' is wrong; river is Shavers Fork of the Cheat)
